result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is visually cut off — both the image and the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' are truncated at the right edge of the screen, with no visual affordance (like a scroll indicator or partial reveal styling) clearly communicating horizontal scrollability.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible scroll hint such as a partially visible card with a clear fade/gradient edge, or include a scroll arrow indicator to signal that the list is horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off vertically at the bottom of the screen with no clear indication of whether it's intentional to hint at more content below.
issues.suggestion: Ensure partial cards cut off at the bottom have enough visible content to clearly imply scrollability, or add a subtle gradient overlay to reinforce the scroll affordance.
